@@U02500@@
Morning sun. The EMPEROR, COURTIERS. 浮士德, and 梅菲斯特, respectably dressed according to the fashion, kneel before the EMPEROR.

@@U02502@@
Sire, do you forgive us last night's fireworks?

@@U02504@@
(Beckoning them to rise.)

@@U02505@@
I could wish for many such entertainments. Suddenly, like 普路托, I saw myself in a glowing sphere that burned all about me. Before me out of a night black as coal, appeared a rocky valley aglow with tiny flares. Out of many a pit surrounding me swirled thousands of savage flames that soared on high and, joining, formed a flickering vault of fire that forever changed its shape. And far in the distance, I saw through its twisted columns of fire, long processions of nations in motion, converging on me in a wide circle, to pay me homage as always. I recognized one and another of my courtiers. I appeared to myself a prince of a thousand salamanders.

@@U02507@@
And so you are, Sire, for each element recognizes your Majesty's supremacy. You've tested fire and proven it obedient, now cast yourself into the sea at its roughest, and scarcely will you have trod the pearl-strewn floor, than pale green heaving waves edged with purple will form about you a glorious round, a lovely place to dwell, with you its central point.
translation:
@@U02500@@
早晨的阳光。皇帝，朝臣。 浮士德和梅菲斯特按照时尚打扮，恭敬地跪在皇帝面前。

@@U02502@@
陛下，您能原谅我们昨晚的烟火吗？

@@U02504@@
（示意他们起身。）

@@U02505@@
我希望有很多这样的娱乐活动。突然，就像普路托一样，我看到自己处于一个发光的球体中，周围燃烧着。在漆黑如煤的夜色中，我面前出现了一座闪烁着微小耀斑的岩石山谷。从我周围的许多深坑中，数以千计的野蛮火焰盘旋而出，它们高高地升起，汇合在一起，形成了一个永远改变形状的闪烁的火穹。在远处，我透过扭曲的火柱看到，列队在行进，在我周围围成一个大圆圈，一如既往地向我致敬。我认出了我的一位又一位朝臣。我对自己来说就像是一千只火蜥蜴的王子。

@@U02507@@
陛下，您也是如此，因为每一个元素都承认您陛下的至高无上。你已经测试过火并证明它是顺从的，现在把自己扔进最汹涌的大海里，你几乎不会踏上铺满珍珠的地板，淡绿色的波涛与紫色的边缘就会在你周围形成一个光荣的圆形，一个可爱的居住地，而你就是它的中心点。
